checks: An unfinished dish exposes the preparation requirement and cannot record a sauce check.

Escape, sideways motion and pointer cancellation restore the spoon and leave saved evidence unchanged.

A four-serving tomato dish in a wide pan on the trivet animates gradual closure at its actual position. Animation never advances cooking or alters evidence.
Picking up the checking spoon pauses a running kitchen throughout the stroke.
